title: OpenAI is making an all-in-one 'superapp' that combines Codex, ChatGPT, and Atlas browser for maximum productivity | TechRadar
summary: OpenAI plans to launch a 'superapp' combining ChatGPT, Atlas, and Codex into one interface, potentially enhancing user experience and simplifying access to AI tools. This move comes amidst competition from Anthropic's agentic capabilities and aims to streamline OpenAI's offerings.
sentiment_reason: The sentiment is positive as the 'superapp' aims to simplify user experience and leverage consumer scale to enhance AI capabilities.
